meta.description: Crawls the configured public financial websites, extracts personal loan products and stores them in the loan_products table.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Fetch Source Page
nodes.notes: One request per registry entry. The page body is stored in the `html` field.

nodes.name: Combine Source And Page
nodes.notes: Re-attaches the source metadata to the crawled page.

parameters.query:
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO loan_products AS lp (
    product_key, product_name, provider, source_id, source_url,
    interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max, min_loan_amount, max_loan_amount,
    min_tenure_months, max_tenure_months, min_monthly_income, max_monthly_income,
    min_credit_score, max_credit_score, min_age, max_age, min_employment_years,
    required_employment_statuses, criteria_signature, criteria, raw, variants,
    updated_at, last_seen_at
  )
  SELECT
    t.product_key, t.product_name, t.provider, t.source_id, t.source_url,
    t.interest_rate_min, t.interest_rate_max, t.min_loan_amount, t.max_loan_amount,
    t.min_tenure_months, t.max_tenure_months, t.min_monthly_income, t.max_monthly_income,
    t.min_credit_score, t.max_credit_score, t.min_age, t.max_age, t.min_employment_years,
    t.required_employment_statuses, t.criteria_signature, t.criteria, t.raw, t.variants,
    NOW(), NOW()
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.products_sql }}::jsonb) AS t(
    product_key text, product_name text, provider text, source_id text, source_url text,
    interest_rate_min numeric, interest_rate_max numeric,
    min_loan_amount numeric, max_loan_amount numeric,
    min_tenure_months int, max_tenure_months int,
    min_monthly_income numeric, max_monthly_income numeric,
    min_credit_score int, max_credit_score int,
    min_age int, max_age int, min_employment_years numeric,
    required_employment_statuses text[], criteria_signature text,
    criteria jsonb, raw jsonb, variants jsonb
  )
  ON CONFLICT (product_key) DO UPDATE SET
    product_name = EXCLUDED.product_name,
    provider = EXCLUDED.provider,
    source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
    interest_rate_min = EXCLUDED.interest_rate_min,
    interest_rate_max = EXCLUDED.interest_rate_max,
    min_loan_amount = EXCLUDED.min_loan_amount,
    max_loan_amount = EXCLUDED.max_loan_amount,
    min_tenure_months = EXCLUDED.min_tenure_months,
    max_tenure_months = EXCLUDED.max_tenure_months,
    min_monthly_income = EXCLUDED.min_monthly_income,
    max_monthly_income = EXCLUDED.max_monthly_income,
    min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
    max_credit_score = EXCLUDED.max_credit_score,
    min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age,
    max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
    min_employment_years = EXCLUDED.min_employment_years,
    required_employment_statuses = EXCLUDED.required_employment_statuses,
    criteria_signature = EXCLUDED.criteria_signature,
    criteria = EXCLUDED.criteria,
    raw = EXCLUDED.raw,
    variants = EXCLUDED.variants,
    updated_at = NOW(),
    last_seen_at = NOW(),
    active = TRUE
  RETURNING product_id, product_key, source_id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
swept AS (
  UPDATE loan_products p
  SET active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE p.source_id = ANY({{ $json.crawled_sources_sql }}::text[])
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upserted u WHERE u.product_key = p.product_key)
  RETURNING product_id
),
run_log AS (
  INSERT INTO discovery_runs (
    run_id, source_id, trigger, status, products_found,
    products_new, products_updated, products_collapsed, error, started_at, finished_at
  )
  SELECT
    gen_random_uuid(),
    r.source_id,
    'schedule',
    r.status,
    COALESCE(r.products_found, 0),
    (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted u WHERE u.inserted AND u.source_id = r.source_id),
    (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted u WHERE NOT u.inserted AND u.source_id = r.source_id),
    COALESCE(r.products_collapsed, 0),
    r.error,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset({{ $json.runs_sql }}::jsonb) AS r(
    source_id text, status text, products_found int, products_collapsed int, error text
  )
  RETURNING run_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted) AS products_total,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted WHERE inserted) AS products_new,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted WHERE NOT inserted) AS products_updated,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM swept) AS products_deactivated,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM run_log) AS runs_logged

nodes.name: Persist Products And Run Log
nodes.notes: Idempotent upsert on product_key, deactivation sweep for products that disappeared from the site, and the discovery run log - in one atomic statement.
